The timeout does not establish a model-quality regression; the likely bottleneck is repeated candidate-attention scoring and checkpoint recomputation. Reduce sampled training transitions and negatives, and process larger score chunks while preserving the same causal model and predictor architecture. Lower the per-category time guard so all four categories have time to finish within the observed trial allocation; actual runtime and validation quality still require execution.
